status: Compiler code reaches a fixed point
summary: Stage3 rebuilt successfully. Its compiler IR and executable exactly match Stage2, and both compilers pass all three smoke checks. Real compiler interfaces and complete current-source testing remain.
activity: Published a checked interface writer with independent Native and actual Cinch consumer validation. The pinned seed builds all43 compiler modules and emits their contracts. Remaining interface categories and staged CLI integration are unfinished; full-suite failure corrections are being checked.

checks.title: Checked interface documents pass real consumers
checks.detail: The new writer passes independent Native schema, canonical bytes and hash-chain checks. Cinch accepts public reexports and refuses hidden constructors and fixity overrides; generic constructor tags and fields are preserved. All43 compiler modules also build with the pinned seed.

checks.title: Checked type export passes independent readback
checks.detail: The self-built Stage3 compiles and runs the exporter. Native accepts five contract forms and independently confirms region/effect metadata. All12 named report rows pass, including stable binder names and explicit refusals. Complete interface documents remain in progress.

checks.title: Rust linear-parameter ownership repaired
checks.detail: A linear parameter used once in its own lambda body was incorrectly rejected. The independent reproduction now passes; all23 ownership tests pass, including refusal of capture, duplicate use and dropped parameters.

checks.title: Self-built compiler rebuilds changed source correctly
checks.detail: Stage2 compiles a modified compiler; that executable produces the changed diagnostic label and correctly refuses the invalid probe. The verification driver now explicitly uses Stage2 for this gate.

checks.title: Stage2 and Stage3 compiler code matches exactly
checks.detail: Candidate23: identical LLVM IR and executable SHA256; Stage3 also passes valid-program, precedence and invalid-source smoke checks. This does not establish the compiler-interface fixed point.

checks.title: Stage2 built and smoke-tested
checks.detail: Candidate23 produces real compiler IR and an executable. The executable starts and compiles/runs valid programs, respects precedence and gives the expected invalid-source refusal.

checks.title: 100 programs executed
checks.detail: 82 runtime cases on candidate 10 and 18 linked-object cases on candidate 14. The linked cases, including the direct intrinsic export, all report zero leaks; the whole object target passed.

checks.title: 35 tooling checks passed
checks.detail: Passed on candidate 18 with the updated library pin and explicit object roots.

checks.title: Every Rust test target compiles
checks.detail: The complete test-target compile check passes on candidate 18. Executing every test is still in progress.

checks.title: Boundary suite passed
checks.detail: Global identity, nominal identity, source instances, and typing checks all passed on candidate 10.

checks.title: Fresh stage frontend passed
checks.detail: Candidate 12 built Stage 1 and passed the complete Stage 2 frontend. Runtime emission still refused the missing dependencies; the extracted root list matches the earlier probe.

checks.title: Intrinsic exports checked on ABI5 and ABI6
checks.detail: Both producers now emit the requested public alias with exact parameter/result word classes. End-to-end and broader regressions are still running.

checks.title: 225 broader Rust checks passed
checks.detail: Candidate 17: unit, arrays, FFI, intrinsic-object, module, ownership and reclamation groups all passed. This is a scoped regression run, not the complete current suite.

checks.title: Full baseline suite running
checks.detail: Candidate23: 57 /205 target groups passed; 3 running; 2 failed. The failures concern stale parser and pipeline expectations. Their corrections have focused evidence; complete corrected-source verification remains.

checks.title: Guarded implementation checks pass
checks.detail: Candidate 20 passes the complete linked-object target: 19 programs report zero leaks, with malformed authority and unsafe calls refused.

checks.title: Fragment-checker regression corrected
checks.detail: Candidate20 passes the complete pinned report: empty signature declarations are accepted. The old fixture expected the earlier unsupported-class diagnostic.

checks.title: All five builder checks passed
checks.detail: Candidate 20 passes exact text, string-concatenation oracle, chunk counts, scale, and 65,536 newline chunks on a 2 MiB stack.

checks.title: All 12 arithmetic and argument-scope cases pass
checks.detail: Candidate 21: Native reference and the compiled Cinch checker accept nested, explicit-binding and direct guarded subtraction, while refusing reversed subtraction and an unjustified upper bound.

checks.title: Actual Stage 1 arithmetic probes pass
checks.detail: Candidate21 seed-built Stage1: nested, explicitly bound and direct guarded subtraction pass; reversed subtraction and unjustified upper bounds are refused. All five outcomes match expectations.

checks.title: Runtime and real CLI regressions pass
checks.detail: Candidate21 passes the complete runtime IR and real CLI targets, including exact numeric values, owned-word reclamation, dictionary ABI and tags/aliases.

checks.title: Direct proof reuse and complete builder checks pass
checks.detail: Candidate23 passes the entire proof certificate regression. Its fresh Stage1 accepts the reduced outer-guard case and complete builder, while refusing an out-of-bounds write.

blockers.title: Write actual compiler interfaces
blockers.detail: The checked writer handles ordinary data and values, including privacy and dependency hashes. Remaining signature, instance, foreign-assumption, refinement, record and effect cases must be completed, then the writer must be connected to the staged compiler CLI.
blockers.technical: The published compiler source exactly matches a successful pinned-seed build of all43 modules. Its interfaces are an authority oracle, not a substitute for Cinch-produced Stage2/Stage3 interface equivalence.

blockers.title: Finish full verification and repair its failures
blockers.detail: The baseline has two recorded failures: missing parser coverage entries and an obsolete expectation that failed compilation removes rather than truncates IR. The corrected table matches all109 actual measured entries; all four stale-IR refusal probes pass. The full pipeline target is queued for recheck.
blockers.technical: Baseline candidate23 is immutable. The coverage correction is being tested on a fresh snapshot; its old failure remains recorded rather than overwritten.

milestones.title: Cinch-built compiler runs its smoke programs
milestones.detail: Stage2 emits actual program code, runs valid cases and refuses invalid source. Its full Stage3 rebuild is underway.

milestones.title: Refined-local checker repair passes
milestones.detail: All 12 argument-scope cases pass against both Native and actual compiled Cinch checking. The tested repair and builder are pushed to main.

milestones.title: Small-stack builder reproduction passes
milestones.detail: 65,536 chunks: old builder exits73 on a2MiB stack; revised builder exits0 on the same stack. Full compiler retry still pending.

milestones.title: Conditional implementation linkage works
milestones.detail: The guarded call executes with zero leaks, while wrong declaring class, method and context are refused. Full compiler emission is now limited by a stack failure.

milestones.title: Requested library bundle built and admitted
milestones.detail: The repaired ABI5 producer builds the actual 29 function and four dictionary root set. Remaining emitter refusals are the same conditional subtraction lookup.

milestones.title: Decimal runtime and intrinsic exports repaired
milestones.detail: 17 linked programs pass the full object target; focused public intrinsic export regressions pass on ABI5 and ABI6.

milestones.title: Subtraction blocker cleared in the full source
milestones.detail: An explicit positive bound clears the frontend and exposes concrete runtime dependency requests.

milestones.title: Checked library objects are consumed
milestones.detail: Published object admission, runtime linkage, pinned dependencies, and returned-function fixes.

milestones.title: Runtime ABI configuration fixed
milestones.detail: A small reproduction now passes; Stage 2 moved beyond its earlier configuration error.
